body:
## What happens

With `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash` answering and mid tool-batch, picking `zhipu/glm-5.3` from `/model` ends the turn with:

```
error: the request could not be sent as it was
```

Reproduces identically on plain `dev` @ `9be565861` with the same tmux script (lane B's drive on the Spark, `~/af-b-reports/`), so it is not #993's. It is #935's cut-and-re-ask (the person's word wins at the request) meeting the new model's rejection of the previous model's tool-call transcript shape.

## Replication a stranger can run

On the Spark, `make build`, then in tmux: `bin/aforge chat --model deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash --yolo`, send `Run this exact shell command and then tell me what it printed: sleep 75 && echo done-waiting`, wait for the bash call to be running, then `/model zhipu/glm-5.3`. The turn ends with the error above instead of the re-asked request answering.

## Acceptance

End-to-end first: the same drive, and after the pick the turn continues on the new model (or the surface says in a person's words why it cannot carry this transcript across), with no `error:` row. Unit: a fake completer for the second model that refuses the first model's tool-call shape, and the cut-and-re-ask either repairs the transcript or refuses in words.

Found by lane B (#993) on 2026-09-12.
